name: SMTP Security Checklist
source: OWASP ASVS + CIS Controls + NIST SP 800-45

items.description: Verify SMTP banners do not expose unnecessary software version details.
Confirm user enumeration commands are disabled or tightly controlled.
Ensure unauthenticated relay attempts are denied for non-local recipients.
Verify STARTTLS is supported where expected and downgrade paths are blocked.
Review dangerous or non-standard command handling under malformed input.
Compare externally exposed behavior with approved baseline configuration.
Validate separation between MX and authenticated submission services.
Confirm AUTH is required for message submission on designated ports.

items.testName: Weak mechanism and plaintext auth checks
items.description: Block weak SASL/auth mechanisms and insecure auth negotiation paths.

items.testName: Rate limiting for brute-force and spam
items.description: Validate limits, tarpitting, and account protection for abusive attempts.
Validate inbound/outbound SPF policy handling and enforcement consistency.
Ensure DKIM signing and verification are configured and functioning.
Verify DMARC policy alignment, reporting, and spoof resilience.
Confirm security monitoring captures auth failures, relays, and anomalous sending.
Disable obsolete protocols/ciphers and enforce modern TLS suites.

items.testName: Certificate validity and trust chain checks
items.description: Validate certificate rotation, SAN coverage, and trust chain health.
Assess resilience to STARTTLS stripping and downgrade attempts.
Test CRLF/header injection handling in SMTP envelope and headers.
Review queue behavior for abuse amplification or resource exhaustion.
Ensure management interfaces are restricted, authenticated, and audited.
Verify private keys and configs are protected during backup workflows.
